metadata.project: Identify Earth Locations that Analog the Permanent Moon Base Locations and Mars
metadata.dem_source: NASA MGS MOLA 128 ppd + HiRISE DTMs

historical_events.title: Perseverance & Ingenuity Touchdown
historical_events.summary: Guided descent via Terrain Relative Navigation. First powered, controlled aerodynamic flight on another planet by the Ingenuity helicopter at Wright Brothers Field.
historical_events.summary_es: Descenso guiado por Terrain Relative Navigation. Primer vuelo aerodinámico controlado en otro planeta por el helicóptero Ingenuity en Wright Brothers Field.

historical_events.title: Delta Front Core Sampling
historical_events.summary: Drilling of fine-grained sedimentary mudstones (Wildcat Ridge) revealing organic molecules and sulfates deposited in an ancient lake.
historical_events.summary_es: Perforación de rocas sedimentarias de grano fino (Wildcat Ridge) con presencia de materia orgánica y sulfatos depositados en un antiguo lago.

historical_events.title: Habitable Environment Confirmed
historical_events.summary: Mudstone drill samples at John Klein and Cumberland confirmed neutral-pH freshwater conditions and key biogenic elements (C, H, N, O, P, S) ~3.7 billion years ago.
historical_events.summary_es: Análisis de lutitas en John Klein y Cumberland demostraron agua dulce con pH neutro y elementos clave (C, H, N, O, P, S) hace ~3,700 millones de años.

historical_events.title: Eberswalde Delta Identification
historical_events.summary: High-resolution orbital imagery provided definitive proof of persistent fluvial activity and prolonged subaqueous sedimentation on early Mars.
historical_events.summary_es: Las imágenes de alta resolución demostraron actividad fluvial persistente y sedimentación subacuática prolongada en Marte.

historical_events.title: Uzboi Vallis Rim Breach
historical_events.title_es: Ruptura del Dique de Uzboi Vallis
historical_events.summary: Catastrophic overflow from Uzboi Vallis breached the southwestern rim of Holden Crater, impounding a deep, long-lived lake.
historical_events.summary_es: El desbordamiento catastrófico de Uzboi Vallis inundó el interior del Cráter Holden formando un lago profundo.

historical_events.title: HiRISE Alluvial Fan Mapping
historical_events.summary: Stereo HiRISE digital terrain models enabled volumetric reconstruction of sediment transport driven by surface runoff.
historical_events.summary_es: Los modelos digitales de elevación HiRISE permitieron reconstruir el volumen de sedimentos transportados por escorrentía superficial.

historical_events.title: MOLA Laser Altimetry & Viking Mapping
historical_events.title_es: Altimetría Láser MOLA y Mapeo Viking
historical_events.summary: Confirmed a summit height of 21.2 km above the Martian datum, built by stationary hotspot volcanism in the absence of plate tectonics.
historical_events.summary_es: Confirmó una altura de 21.2 km sobre el datum marciano, producto de volcanismo estacionario sin tectónica de placas.
